text:
1. Compared with the earlier promise, the apparent difference narrows.
2. Isaac is the child of the covenant.
3. Isaac is the one through whom the nations are to be blessed.
4. The promise concerning Isaac is turned into a test in this scene.
5. The scene turns on the single Hebrew word "hineni," meaning "here I am."
6. Abraham says "hineni" three times.
7. Abraham says "hineni" to God, to Isaac, and to the angel.
8. The word "hineni" means something different each time Abraham says it.
9. Each time Abraham says "hineni," it costs him more.
